description: Creates an alert on the linked SupaPark account that fires when a reservation time opens at a Walt Disney World restaurant for the given date and party size (each newly opened time alerts, even if other times were already open). Optionally limit it to a meal or a time window, or, when the guest already holds a table that day, to times better than that one. Tables seat 1 to 10; for a bigger group pass pair_sizes (e.g. [6, 5] for 11) and it alerts only when both tables open within pair_gap_min minutes of each other on that date. Requires a linked SupaPark account (pairing key).

client_label.description: Optional: who this watch is for, e.g. a travel advisor's client name or booking reference (40 characters max). Shown on the watch in SupaPark and returned by list_my_watches.

earliest_time.description: Optional: only alert for times at or after this, 24-hour HH:MM (e.g. "17:00").

held_time.description: Optional: the time of the table the guest already holds on this date, 24-hour HH:MM (e.g. "20:45"). Then only a better time alerts: one closer to target_time when given, otherwise any other time inside the meal / time window.

latest_time.description: Optional: only alert for times at or before this, 24-hour HH:MM (e.g. "20:00").

meal.description: Optional: only alert for this meal (breakfast before 11 AM, lunch 11 AM–4 PM, dinner from 4 PM).

pair_gap_min.description: Optional, with pair_sizes: how many minutes apart the two tables may be (default 30).

pair_sizes.description: Optional, for a group too big for one table: the two table sizes that seat it together, e.g. [6, 5] for a group of 11 (each 2 to 10). party_size is then the whole group. One watch: it alerts only when both tables have a time open on the date within pair_gap_min minutes of each other.

party_size.description: How many people: 1 to 10 for one table; with pair_sizes, the whole group (the two sizes added up, up to 20).

target_time.description: Optional, needs held_time: the time the guest actually wants, 24-hour HH:MM (e.g. "18:00"), inside the meal / time window. An opening alerts only when it is strictly closer to this than held_time is.

name: watch_dining
title: Watch a dining reservation
